The sound of helicopters can be heard over desert camp that the Alkiragunya council is curently in, as several helicopters of different sizes fly over it at a high altitude before they decent a dictance away from the camp to land in the desert, after some time three tracked APC's comes driving towards the camp from between the dunes and stops at the edge of the camp were soldiers light desert body armor comes out of two of the APC's and makes a small peremiter around the vehicles, though there guns are pointed downwards in a show of non-agression with there finger being intentionaly kept away from the trigger, from the last APC there emerges 4 important looking induviduals as well as Tau, carrying a suitcase, that walks infront of them.

The first man that takes the lead of the four is a man of medium muscular build and 6 ft. high, with a tan skin complexion, long golden blond hair that is braided into a singular tick braid on the back of his head and a extended goatee beard style and green eyes, he wears a profesional black business suit.

The secound man to the left of the first man is a burly and muscular build man that is only 5'2" ft. tall, with an almost bronzen skin, long dark brown hair that goes down to his shoulders and a long beard that reaches his chest, his eyes are brown-green and he usualy wears an old faioned brown suit with a vest were you can see the silver chain of a pocket watch.

To the right of the first is the third man, he is an old man that is of average build for his age and 5'6" ft. in height, with dark brown skin, brown eyes and grey(that whas ones black) hair and beard of medium lenght that is straight and wavy, he is wearing a sand colored robe that is obviusly of the religous kind with brown details and the old native symbol of the sun on the chest, in his right hand he holds a long wooden staff that looks like to vines coiled around eachother like snakes with a golden crystal on the topp that shines like the sun when the light hits it.

The last of the four walks behind the other three, with a slender but atletic build, 5'8" ft. tall, chocolate brown skin, short black hair, a cleanly shaven face and piercing green eyes, he wears a white 3 piece suit that has a long jacket and he always seem to have suit case with him thats is a forest green color joust like the tie and buttons of his suit, he gives of an air of being highly educated.

This group is not followed by any of the soldiers, proberly to show that they trust the Alkiragunya to not attack them.

They calmly aproche the tent of the Alkiragunya council, when they get to the tent Tau speaks up.

[i][b]The Rising Tension in West Argos[/b]

Tensions have escalated along the West Argos Coastline between Oceanice and ULR-New Westmore. At 6:05 AM, May 10, Oceanice Defense Minister Ivan Hans ordered an AGM-84 Harpoon Block II missile strike on what was believed to be an unauthorized ULR vessel near the Oceanice coastline. Tragically, the targeted ship was later identified as the cruise liner Carnival Breeze, en route to Westmore. The attack has sparked outrage in both ULR and New Westmore. 

[b]The Water Blue Line
[/b]
The Oceanice Government has placed the blame on ULR and New Westmore, asserting that the vessel entered Oceanices self declared Claim Sea zone. A region is considered sovereign territory. In response, Oceanice has declared a no-shipping zone for all ULR and New Westmore vessels, effectively barring entry to its waters. The Blue Water Line Oceanice has formalized its claims over the Sea by establishing the Blue Water Line with the establishment of a defensive maritime zone patrolled by the National Guard Navy. The area is restricted to any vessels. Oceanice has used the defense forces of destroyers, frigates, corvettes, submarines, and patrol boats to enforce the blockade. Allowing only cargo to go on the Water Blue Line. The Oceanice has established a naval dominance over the straight coast of West Argos, further asserting claims over parts of the sea with naval forces.
